title: Great, but pricey
text: I was offered a discounted first box, and I would not hesitate to order another at that price. We really enjoyed the snacks that came and were able to discover some new to us healthy options that we really love. There were even two pouches of beef jerky in our box of 25 snacks, which made it an even better value as that is an expensive snack. It was fun being surprised, and my 9 year-old had fun trying some new things. Someone liked almost everything in the box. I'm tempted to continue the subscription at full price, but there just isn't enough room in our grocery budget.
label: positive
